tagline: A new hotel, two minutes from Kabalana

copyBlocks.heading: Off the main road, over the surf
copyBlocks.body:
Kabalana Beach is a two-minute walk. The main road is not — the hotel sits back from it, which is the difference between sleeping and listening to tuk-tuks all night.

Cafés and restaurants are in every direction. The pool is in the middle of the hotel, and most evenings that is where people end up.

copyBlocks.heading: New, and it shows
copyBlocks.body:
The hotel opened recently enough that one guest wrote he was the first customer. Everything is still new: the rooms, the bathrooms, the air conditioning. Guests score it 9.7 out of 10 for cleanliness and 9.7 for comfort on Booking.com, across 34 reviews, and 5.0 on Google across 21.

Rooms are large — larger than the rate suggests, which is the most common thing said about the place after the staff.

copyBlocks.heading: The staff are the reason people extend
copyBlocks.body: More than one guest has moved hotels, landed here, and stayed. One stayed over a month. Another cancelled the next hotel and stayed put. Staff score 9.4 on Booking.com.

copyBlocks.heading: Nine kinds of room
copyBlocks.body:
King rooms with a balcony, a garden view, or a private patio onto the pool. Superior kings. Family studios and junior suites that sleep four, and a two-bedroom suite that sleeps five.

Every room has air conditioning, a private bathroom, soundproofing, a work desk and free WiFi. Rates depend on the room and the dates — the booking links show what is free.

copyBlocks.heading: Pool, restaurant, spa
copyBlocks.body:
An outdoor pool, open all year, in the middle of the hotel. A restaurant serving breakfast with local specialities and fresh pastries, and Chinese, Indian and Italian through the day. A coffee house on site. A spa and wellness centre.

For families: family rooms, kids' meals, an outdoor play area and babysitting on request.

copyBlocks.heading: Practicalities
copyBlocks.body:
A 24-hour front desk, with private and express check-in. Free private parking on site, by reservation. An airport shuttle — Koggala Airport is about 5 km away.

Daily housekeeping, laundry, dry cleaning and ironing. Bicycle rental. Facilities for guests with disabilities. Non-smoking rooms.

spot: Kabalana: a sandy beach break that suits beginners and improvers, with The Rock reef alongside it when the swell is up.
